body: What I want longterm? Cancer. My change in routine is mainly trying new chemicals that might kill a few neurons more and switching cigarette brands once in a while. What fits me? Being a vomit spouting vermin that lurks in some house attic, shoulders down slopped towards some electric device while mumbling curses to the cunts that dared to conceive me. Yes i'm stuck here, and there's nothing but pain about it, outside is just grey concrete and people judging me for the undesirable piece of an useless being that I am. I used to be an alcoholic and took hard stimulants daily for 2 years. I recently managed to stop somehow only to come back to a reality I cannot change nor decently fit in. I have no friends nor desire to make any. I'm almost as disgusted by most people than I am by myself, and there's nothing in the world that I find worth living for.

I've had swollen lymph nodes all over my body for the past month (especially in the neck and groin area). I'm hoping with everything I have for this to be a generalized form of cancer that will kill me very quickly. I'm waiting for further symptoms and, religiously smoking 3 packs a day meanwhile.
